cleanupService.title: Cleanup Service

operation.deleteNonRatedResults: Delete feedback of old non-rated results
operation.deleteOldRatedResults: Delete feedback of old rated results
operation.deleteOldFeedback: Delete feedback of non-latest results (old courses)
operation.warnOldCoursesReset: Warn instructors of old courses (archive + email)
operation.resetOldCourses: Reset student data of old courses
operation.deleteOldCourseSubmissionVersions: Delete submission versions of old courses
operation.warnNotEnrolledUsers: Warn users not enrolled in any course (email)
operation.deleteNotEnrolledUsers: Delete warned users not enrolled in any course
operation.deletePlagiarismCases: Delete plagiarism cases of old courses

tooltip.deleteOrphans: Deletes orphaned entities that are no longer associated with valid results or participations. This includes feedback, text blocks, and scores that reference null results, participations, or submissions.
tooltip.deletePlagiarismComparisons: Deletes plagiarism comparisons with a status of "None" that belong to courses within the specified date range. A status of "None" indicates that the plagiarism incident has not yet been reviewed.
tooltip.deleteNonRatedResults: Deletes non-rated results, excluding the latest non-rated result for each participation (to be able to compute Competencies Scores), within the specified date range, along with associated long feedback texts, text blocks, feedback items, and participant scores.
tooltip.deleteOldRatedResults: Deletes rated results, excluding the latest rated result for each participation, for courses conducted within the specified date range. Also deletes associated long feedback texts, text blocks, feedback items, and participant scores.
tooltip.deleteOldSubmissionVersions: Deletes old submission versions. The last submission will not be deleted, as it is always stored in the corresponding Submission subclass.
tooltip.deleteOldFeedback: Deletes the feedback (feedback, long feedback texts, text blocks) of non-latest results for courses that ended before the configured cutoff. The results themselves and the feedback of the latest rated and latest non-rated result per participation are kept.
tooltip.warnOldCoursesReset: Archives every old course whose configured data-retention period has elapsed (by default 1 year for non-grade-relevant and 5 years for grade-relevant courses) and emails its instructors a download link plus a notice that the student data will be deleted after the configured grace period. Course material is kept.
tooltip.resetOldCourses: Deletes all student data of old courses that are past the reset grace period (and were already archived), while keeping the course material. This action cannot be undone.
tooltip.deleteOldCourseSubmissionVersions: Deletes the submission versions (editor keystroke history) of courses that ended before the configured cutoff.
tooltip.warnNotEnrolledUsers: Emails users who are enrolled in no course and have been inactive beyond the configured guard period, warning that their account will be deleted after the grace period. Logging in cancels the deletion. Administrators are not affected.
tooltip.deleteNotEnrolledUsers: Permanently deletes warned users who are still enrolled in no course, whose grace period has elapsed, who have not logged in since the warning, and who have no remaining domain references. Blocked users remain unchanged. Administrators are not affected.
tooltip.deletePlagiarismCases: Deletes the plagiarism cases (with their notification posts) of courses that ended before the grade-relevant retention cutoff (5 years by default). Plagiarism cases are grade-relevant records and share the same retention period as other exam data. This action cannot be undone.
